Prime Beef Joint

Prime Beef Joint is used in 4 campfire recipes in Red Dead Redemption 2. It comes from 4 animals, including Bison, Bull, Cow, Ox.

Type
Meat

Animals

  • BisonSniper Rifle
  • BullSniper Rifle
  • CowSniper Rifle
  • OxSniper Rifle

Recipes used in

  • 1x for Minty Prime BeefCampfire
  • 1x for Oregano Prime BeefCampfire
  • 1x for Plain Prime BeefCampfire
  • 1x for Thyme Prime BeefCampfire
